messages:
alina: heads-up — we just got a large spike of 504s on hosted-api (region-eu-west) at ~02:40 UTC. pager fired: some downstream redis timeouts + a bad rolling deploy. impact: writes slowed, a few customer write requests retried by clients and one partner reported a 5xx on webhook delivery.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: [INC-2026-455] hosted-api 504 spike — severity: P2 — triggered at 1799005555
alina: quick timeline I captured: 02:40 alert -> 02:42 first ack (raj) -> 02:45 scaled app nodes up and bumped redis connections -> 02:48 rolled back deploy -> 02:50 partial recovery -> 02:57 full recovery.
raj: confirming — root cause appears to be a combination of an unlucky deploy that changed connection pooling and a backlog in redis replica promotion. the deploy increased concurrent connections briefly which pushed a few redis replicas over the threshold.
emma: FYI the PD alert payload didn't include the deploy id, code-commit, or link to the redis runbook. took a bit to assemble those which slowed the decision to roll back.
taylor: suggests: incident-bot should auto-attach three things to the post-incident doc: deploy id, last 5 deploy logs, and the top APM trace link. those are the most time-consuming bits to fetch.
alina: proposal for automation flow: 1) incident-bot detects incident closure (no new pages for 12m) -> 2) bot runs a create-pm flow that generates a postmortem skeleton including timeline, impact summary, and prefilled fields (deploy id, trace, runbook link) -> 3) bot opens one or more actions in the remediation tracker and assigns using CODEOWNERS-style mapping -> 4) posts back in thread with PM link + scheduling poll.
oncall-bot: Example command: `/inc create-pm INC-2026-455 --owner @raj --severity P2 --impact "partial write failures, partner webhook errors" --attach deploy,trace,runbook --auto-schedule 24h`
emma: nice. addition: include a short "handoff snapshot" block in the PM that captures who acknowledged, what context they had, and any missing runbook elements. we can auto-diff that against runbook coverage to find gaps.
raj: for auto-assignment, mapping rules should be overridable. default mapping: services/indexer/* -> @raj, services/deploy/* -> @alina, infra/redis/* -> @taylor. allow a fallback `@eng-oncall` pool for unmapped items.
taylor: dashboard idea (different from previous): a recurrence heatmap by service + incident fingerprinting (stack + deploy id) so owners can see repeating patterns; plus a remediation aging timeline that grades risk. filters: customer-impacting only, unresolved > 7d, owners with >3 overdue items.
alina: security note: PMs sometimes require attaching logs. ensure the bot creates expiring, SSO-gated links to logs and marks sensitive items. add a checkbox in PM for 'escalate to security' if PII seen.
emma: UX request: one-click Slack interactive button "Create PM & Action" in the incident thread. reduces copy/paste friction. it should open a small modal to confirm owner and severity.
oncall-bot: scheduling: honor contributor timezones, present 3 relative options (24h/48h/72h) when creating the PM. include a snooze option for slower teams. polls should collect timezone preferences.
taylor: quick wins list and rough estimates: - add deploy/runbook/trace to PD payload (1d) - `/inc create-pm` minimal flag + create skeleton (3d) - interactive Slack button + modal (5d) - CODEOWNERS mapping import for auto-assign (1w) - remediation dashboard spike heatmap prototype (3w)
raj: volunteers: i'll own the CODEOWNERS mapping import and initial assign rules. emma will own the bot modal and interactive flow. alina will author the PM skeleton templates and the handoff snapshot schema. taylor will sketch the dashboard prototype and coordinate with product.
emma: I'll start a small PR to incident-bot that emits PM JSON to /internal/postmortem-api and adds a feature flag behind alpha.
alina: good. timeline ask: prototype in 2 weeks, alpha rollout to the eng org in 5 weeks. can we commit to that?
taylor: OK from product side, will prioritize wireframe and acceptance criteria.
oncall-bot: Poll: React with :thumbsup: to accept meeting time 2026-06-01 09:00 UTC for the postmortem review (24h after auto-create). React :eyes: to propose alternatives.
emma: :thumbsup:
raj: :thumbsup:
taylor: :thumbsup:
alina: I'll file a short RFC with the flow and link it here. once the bot can create the PM skeleton we'll let the bot schedule the meeting and auto-invite the short list of responders. moving followups to the postmortem doc; closing this thread for live mitigation notes.
